requirement.text: All credit card information will be secured on the server  and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators.  Information will be encrypted in the database.

initial_eus.title: Protection of Credit Card Information
initial_eus.description: As a customer, I want my credit card information to be secured on the server, so that it is protected from unauthorized access.
work_items: All credit card information shall be secured on the server.
Credit card information shall be accessible only to authorized Izogn administrators.
Credit card information shall be encrypted in the database.

analysis.ethical_objective: Protect the confidentiality and security of users' credit card information by securing it on the server, restricting access to authorized Izogn administrators, and encrypting it in the database.

obligations.text: All credit card information shall be secured on the server.
obligations.source_span: All credit card information will be secured on the server

obligations.text: Credit card information shall be accessible only by authorized Izogn administrators.
obligations.source_span: only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators

obligations.text: Credit card information shall be encrypted in the database.
obligations.source_span: Information will be encrypted in the database.

constraints: Applies to all credit card information handled by the system.
Access to credit card information is restricted to authorized Izogn administrators.
Encryption applies to credit card information stored in the database.
ambiguities: 'Secured on the server' does not specify what security measures are meant beyond encryption in the database.
'Information will be encrypted in the database' most plausibly refers to credit card information, but the sentence does not explicitly restate the subject.
The source does not define how an Izogn administrator becomes 'authorized' or who grants authorization.
The source does not state whether the restriction to administrators excludes users from viewing their own credit card information.
The source does not specify whether encryption is required in transit or only at rest in the database.
unsupported_assumptions_to_avoid: Do not assume a specific encryption algorithm, key length, or key management approach.
Do not assume a specific access control mechanism (e.g., role-based access control, multi-factor authentication).
Do not assume compliance with any particular standard or law (e.g., PCI DSS) since none is cited.
Do not assume audit logging or monitoring of administrator access is required.
Do not assume a retention period or deletion requirement for credit card information.
Do not assume the number of administrators or an approval workflow for authorization.
possible_operational_aspects: Credit card information stored on the server is protected against unauthorized access.
Access to credit card information is limited to Izogn administrators who are authorized.
Credit card information held in the database is stored in encrypted form.

work_items.explanation: Restates the obligation that all credit card information be secured on the server.
Restricts access to credit card information to authorized Izogn administrators, matching the access limitation obligation.
Requires credit card information to be encrypted in the database, matching the encryption obligation.
